tasks.description: Migrate to Azure Database for MySQL
tasks.requirements: Move the application database to Azure Database for MySQL, update JDBC configuration and secure networking, and validate data access and backups.

tasks.description: Containerize Java Application for Container Readiness
tasks.requirements: Create a production-ready container definition, ensure container startup and port exposure are correct, and prepare the app for Azure container hosting.

tasks.description: Migrate Other Cache Solutions to Azure Managed Redis
tasks.requirements: Replace HTTP session reliance on local or app-server state with Azure Managed Redis, including session serialization, timeout settings, and deployment validation.
Eliminate hardcoded database and service credentials from source code and move them to Azure-configured secret storage or environment-driven configuration.

tasks.description: Migrate the Local Resource to Azure
tasks.requirements: Replace localhost-dependent resources with Azure-hosted equivalents, update connection configuration, and verify remote connectivity from the web application.
Identify and replace hardcoded URLs with configuration-based endpoints, making the app environment-safe and Azure deployment aware.
Audit request, response, and servlet encoding to ensure UTF-8 is set explicitly and all character handling meets cloud and localization expectations.
Upgrade the project to a supported Azure-ready Java LTS version and validate compile and runtime compatibility across the app and deployment stack.
